key_rationale: With headline CPI at 5.55% and core inflation moderating to 4.10%, the real repo rate is now comfortably in positive territory, aligning with my preference for a neutral stance. Given the output gap of 0.60% and the supply-side nature of food price shocks, maintaining the current 6.50% repo rate provides the necessary stability to support growth while ensuring inflation converges toward the 4% target.
